Professional Summary
QA Automation professional with hands-on experience designing and executing automation frameworks, building CI pipelines, and improving test coverage for web and hybrid applications. Skilled in scripting, test planning and collaborating across product and engineering teams. Notice period: 15 days.

Technical Skills
Selenium, Test Automation, Java, Jenkins, Playwright, Git, Confluence, Jira

- Integrated Playwright tests into Jenkins pipelines to enable nightly regression runs with Git-triggered jobs, improving defect detection early in the cycle.
- Collaborated with product and engineering via Jira and Confluence to backlog flaky tests and document test strategies, improving test stability metrics month-over-month.

- Implemented Test Automation for critical checkout and payments modules using Java and Playwright, increasing automated coverage for smoke and regression suites by 50%.

- Automated CI jobs in Jenkins and managed test artifacts in Git, enabling faster triage and reproducible test runs; documented test plans and runbooks in Confluence.

QA Automation Engineer, Finlytics (Jun 2022 - Jan 2024)
- Created end-to-end Test Automation frameworks for financial dashboards using Playwright and Java, enabling automated validation of data visualizations and export features.
- Configured Jenkins pipelines to run scheduled Playwright suites and publish test reports, decreasing manual regression cycles by 40%.
- Coordinated with QA and dev teams through Jira and Confluence to prioritize automation efforts and stabilize flaky tests in the suite.
